description:
Overview

Huron helps its clients drive growth, enhance performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. We collaborate with education organizations to develop strategies and implement solutions that enable transformative change. Today, leaders of higher education institutions and academic medical centers are spending too much time reacting to market forces, rather than focusing on essential priorities that help students, faculty and staff thrive. The most productive path forward requires an intentional approach and innovative thinking, whereby stakeholders across the entire institution rally around a shared vision and embrace the hard work of effecting change. You’ll help our clients to achieve organizational effectiveness, improve student outcomes, implement new technologies and align resources and investments to ensure long-term sustainability. Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future.

The multi-faceted role you’ve been looking for… Managers play a vibrant, integral role at Huron. Their invaluable knowledge reflects in the projects they manage, and the teams they lead. Managers build long-standing partnerships with clients, while collaborating with colleagues to solve their most important challenges. In fact, they shape and deliver results that seamlessly align with client goals, visions and missions. Remarkably versatile, our Managers also spend significant time mentoring junior staff on the engagement team—where they tirelessly share expertise as well as feedback and encouragement. This benefits Huron profoundly as it promotes a culture of respect, unity, collaboration, and personal achievement.

Our environment inspires and rewards growth… As a Manager, you have the unique ability to specialize in certain areas that showcase and employ your areas of expertise while you pursue your “career vision.” Huron is big enough to offer the opportunity and exposure you need for your career growth—but small enough to give you individual attention for your professional development. Every colleague adds to who we are as an organization—and the more you evolve, the more we do. An exciting career experience awaits you: It’s intense… it’s analytically rigorous… it’s practical… it’s entrepreneurial… it’s intellectually stimulating—and most definitely—it’s career-defining… It’s the Huron Way!

Responsibilities

  • As Consulting Manager, Higher Education Spend Management you will lead multiple operational assessments, reviewing and analyzing processes, policies, roles, responsibilities, and supporting technologies to develop actionable recommendations for implementation.
  • You will support procurement transformation efforts, particularly within prominent Higher Education institutions, focusing on business process optimization, organizational design, policy creation, technology enhancements and change advisory. Your role will ensure the effective execution of procurement strategies, driving operational excellence and efficiency across the organization.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders across academic departments, administrative offices, and finance teams to identify opportunities for cost savings, risk mitigation, and improved processes. Evaluate current procurement practices, including sourcing, contract management, supplier information management, travel and expense, accounts payable and spend analytics, to recommend innovative solutions tailored to the unique needs of higher education environments.
  • Develop training programs for faculty and staff and identify ways to support compliance with regulatory requirements and institutional policies.
  • Facilitate workshops and strategy sessions to help clients build consensus around change initiatives, guiding them through the complexities of procurement modernization. Leverage data-driven insights and best practices to help institutions achieve transparency, accountability, and sustainability in procurement operations.
  • Help institutions navigate challenges such as decentralized purchasing, budget constraints, and evolving technology landscapes while contributing to the institution’s mission of delivering high-quality education and research outcomes.

Required

  • Current permanent U.S. work authorization
  • Bachelor's Degree from an accredited college or university
  • A minimum of 7 years of procurement and payable related experience, either in a consultative or substantial operational role
  • A minimum of 2 years of relevant managerial experience leading and developing teams
  • Willingness to travel up to 50%

Preferred

  • Consulting experience
  • Higher Education experience
  • Experience working within Travel and Expense and/or with T&E software products (Concur, Chrome River, etc.)

Compensation

The estimated base salary range for this job is $130,000 - $175,000. The range represents a good faith estimate of the range that Huron reasonably expects to pay for this job at the time of the job posting. The actual salary paid to an individual will vary based on multiple factors, including but not limited to specific skills or certifications, years of experience, market changes, and required travel. This job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s annual incentive compensation program, which reflects Huron’s pay for performance philosophy. Inclusive of annual incentive compensation opportunity, the total estimated compensation range for this job is $149,500 - $218,750. The job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s benefit plans which include medical, dental and vision coverage and other wellness programs. Extensive knowledge of core security architectures, history, and trends spanning network, endpoint, and hybrid environments.

Knowledge of security areas such as network security, SASE / Zero Trust, cloud security, identity management, security operations, SIEM, endpoint security, and emerging topics related to cybersecurity and AI.

  • Own the end-to-end lifecycle marketing strategy, from onboarding to retention, upsell, and advocacy.

  • Partner with Product, Data, and Growth to deliver personalized, customer-centric experiences.
  • Develop segmentation and targeting strategies to increase engagement, reduce churn, and grow LTV.
  • Establish KPIs and ensure continuous testing, measurement, and iteration of lifecycle initiatives.
  • Champion automation, personalization, and data-driven decision-making across the lifecycle function.

Application process

  1. Interview with recruiter
  2. Interview with future manager
  3. Interview with team members (no managers present)
  4. Bar Raiser Interview
  5. Prior employment verification check

The annual salary range for this full-time position is $179,300 — $302,600 USD.

Benefits

Our full benefits & perks are explained in our handbook at remote.com/r/benefits. As a global company, each country works differently, but some benefits/perks are for all Remoters:

  • work from anywhere
  • flexible paid time off
  • flexible working hours (we are async)
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave
  • mental health support services
  • stock options
  • learning budget
  • home office budget & IT equipment
  • budget for local in-person social events or co-working spaces

How you’ll plan your day (and life)

We work async at Remote which means you can plan your schedule around your life (and not around meetings). Read more at remote.com/async.

You will be empowered to take ownership and be proactive. When in doubt you will default to action instead of waiting. Your life-work balance is important and you will be encouraged to put yourself and your family first, and fit work around your needs.

If that sounds like something you want, apply now!

  1. Please fill out the form below and upload your CV with a PDF format.
  2. We kindly ask you to submit your application and CV in English, as this is the standardised language we use here at Remote.

Job Profile Summary

The Director, IT Portfolio Management & Agile Services collaborates with the business portfolio team to align the IT portfolio and demand, while coaching and mentoring leaders and teams to instill enterprise-wide adoption of Agile methodologies and practices. The Director requires an in-depth understanding of how organizational capabilities interrelate across the function or segment, with emphasis on Growth & Digital priorities and Lean Portfolio Management to align strategy and execution.

Job Description

The Director, IT Portfolio Management & Agile Services organizes and prioritizes projects and programs based on IT strategy, strategic roadmap, and available and prioritized budgets, and ensures that the appropriate financial and organizational support is allocated in support of those goals. The Director coaches, educates, and mentors leaders and teams to enable scaled, sustainable adoption of Agile practices (e.g., Scrum, Kanban, SAFe), promoting a culture of collaboration, transparency, predictability, and velocity.

The role establishes and maintains Lean Portfolio Management and Agile practices, standards, and guidelines to support transparent decision-making, investment funding, portfolio operations, and governance for the Growth & Digital portfolio. Decisions are typically related to the implementation of new/updated programs or large-scale projects for the function and supporting technical/operational procedures and processes, and the role implements strategic plans, drives goals and objectives, improves performance, and provides input into the function’s strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Establish and maintain Lean Portfolio Management methodologies, standards, and guidelines for the Growth & Digital portfolio

  • Lead a team of Portfolio Management Specialists to:

  • Manage the portfolio budget, providing regular updates on cost forecasting and actual spend

  • Execute annual portfolio planning and value justification

  • Lead a team of Agile Coaches to continuously mature Agile practices across Scrum Teams and Agile Release Trains, including coaching leaders and teams to adopt scaled practices (e.g., SAFe)

  • Partner with business and technology leaders to ensure portfolio prioritization aligns to strategy, outcomes, and financial targets; drive visibility into investment decisions, risks, and value realization

  • Promote a culture of innovation and continuous improvement by advancing Agile processes and Lean-Agile leadership behaviors across the segment

Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in IT portfolio management, program management, or related leadership roles

  • 5 or more years of management experience

  • Demonstrated success leading Lean Portfolio Management and Agile transformations at scale, including coaching executives, leaders, and teams

  • Strong financial acumen with proven experience leading prioritization processes, executive alignment, forecasting, and value realization

  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and relationship-building skills with the ability to influence at all levels of the organization

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines with attention to detail

  • Advanced experience leading special projects and producing metrics, measurements and trend reports

  • Must be passionate about contributing to an organization focused on continuously improving consumer experiences

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA or other Advanced Degree

  • Possess a solid understanding of operations, technology, communications and processes

  • Relevant SAFe certifications such as SAFe Program Consultant, SAFe Lean Portfolio Management, and SAFe Agilist

Additional Information

Work-At-Home Requirements

  • WAH requirements: Must have the ability to provide a high speed DSL or cable modem for a home office. Associates or contractors who live and work from home in the state of California will be provided payment for their internet expense.

  • A minimum standard speed for optimal performance of 25x10 (25 Mbps download x 10 Mbps upload) is required.

  • Satellite and Wireless Internet service is NOT allowed for this role.

  • A dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information

#LI-Remote

Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours : 40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc. $156,600 - $215,400 per year

This job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, volunteer time off, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.

About us

Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is committed to putting health first – for our teammates, our customers and our company. Through our Humana insurance services and CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare, Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large.

Equal Opportunity Employer

It is also the policy of Humana to take affirmative action, in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and VEVRAA, to employ and to advance in employment individuals with disability or protected veteran status, and to base all employment decisions only on valid job requirements. Overview

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

About the Role

We are building the infrastructure of the automotive aftermarket in Latin America, and the Vertical Manager – Auto Parts will own one of its most strategic missions: digitizing and scaling millions of SKUs across Tier 1, 2, and 3, while shaping the future of our marketplace.

This role is designed for someone ready to go beyond Key Account Management and step into a position of ownership, strategy, and impact. The ideal candidate will combine analytical rigor, commercial instinct, and executional drive to lead the growth of the most critical vertical in our ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

  • Vertical Ownership: Define and execute the end-to-end strategy for the auto parts vertical, driving sustainable growth, adoption, and profitability.
  • Catalog Leadership: Build and maintain a digital catalog of millions of SKUs, ensuring accuracy, compatibility, and seamless integration.
  • Strategic Partnerships: Negotiate and manage relationships with Tier 1 OEMs, Tier 2 manufacturers, and Tier 3 distributors to secure competitive assortment and availability.
  • P&L Management: Own key business metrics (GMV, conversion, margins, and supplier performance) and act decisively to improve them.
  • Data-Driven Execution: Use advanced analytics and market intelligence to identify trends, forecast demand, and design growth strategies.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product, operations, and tech teams to optimize catalog integration, procurement workflows, and customer experience.
  • Market Vision: Anticipate industry shifts and competitive dynamics to position the marketplace ahead of the curve.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in marketplaces, e-commerce, automotive, or retail category management / business development.
  • Strong track record in catalog management, supplier negotiation, and delivering measurable growth.
  • Excellent analytical skills with proficiency in Excel, SQL, or BI tools.
  • Strategic mindset with hands-on execution capabilities.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills at senior levels.
  • Fluent in Spanish (Mexico) or Portuguese (Brazil), with advanced English.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to lead the most strategic vertical in one of the largest industries in Latin America.
  • A role designed for growth, with direct exposure to C-level leadership and investors.
  • A high-impact environment where your decisions shape the future of the business.
  • Competitive compensation package with performance-based incentives.

  • São Paulo: BRL R$18,900 – R$24,200 gross / month + bonus.

MISSÃO DO CARGO
Gerenciar, coordenar e supervisionar equipes administrativas e operacionais, assegurando o cumprimento dos contratos firmados com clientes públicos e privados, com foco principal nas operações de contratos no ramo de logística. Garantir o efetivo de mão de obra, a eficiência dos processos e a excelência no atendimento ao cliente, atuando de forma estratégica e prática (“hands on”).

Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir equipes administrativas e operacionais com o objetivo de assegurar o efetivo completo de mão de obra nos contratos sob sua gestão.
  • Planejar, organizar e monitorar o ciclo completo de gestão de pessoas: recrutamento, seleção, admissão, acompanhamento, desligamento e movimentações internas.

  • Anuais

    • Revisão de procedimentos operacionais e indicadores da área.

  • Escolaridade: Ensino superior completo em Administração, Logística, Gestão de Pessoas ou áreas correlatas.

description:
Overview

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Type: Full-time

100% Remote

About the Role

We are building the infrastructure of the automotive aftermarket in Latin America, and the Vertical Manager – Auto Parts will own one of its most strategic missions: digitizing and scaling millions of SKUs across Tier 1, 2, and 3, while shaping the future of our marketplace.

This role is designed for someone ready to go beyond Key Account Management and step into a position of ownership, strategy, and impact. The ideal candidate will combine analytical rigor, commercial instinct, and executional drive to lead the growth of the most critical vertical in our ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

  • Vertical Ownership: Define and execute the end-to-end strategy for the auto parts vertical, driving sustainable growth, adoption, and profitability.
  • Catalog Leadership: Build and maintain a digital catalog of millions of SKUs, ensuring accuracy, compatibility, and seamless integration.
  • Strategic Partnerships: Negotiate and manage relationships with Tier 1 OEMs, Tier 2 manufacturers, and Tier 3 distributors to secure competitive assortment and availability.

title: Operating Partner
description:
Overview

An operating partner is a business leader who works with a company's leadership team to improve the business and create value for shareholders. They are often a key part of a firm's investment strategy and act as a liaison between the firm and its portfolio company. Their responsibilities can include:

  • Advising and coaching — Working with the CEO and management team to provide perspectives and recommendations.
  • Analyzing challenges — Identifying areas for improvement and developing plans to increase efficiency and growth.
  • Creating strategies — Developing plans to increase profits and cash flow, and implement operational best practices.
  • Monitoring performance — Tracking key performance indicators (KPIs) and financial performance.
  • Facilitating value creation — Ensuring the portfolio company has the resources to meet the firm's investment goals.
  • Supporting growth — Assisting with planning, forecasting, and due diligence to support company growth and expansion.
  • Building reporting — Creating simple, consistent reporting that makes it easy to identify when the company is off-track.
  • Leadership — To run a company you must be a leader. Full stop - no excuses. We are looking for Operating Partners who are natural born leaders.

What is the Cache Operating Partner Program?

The Cache Operating Partner Program is your opportunity to partner with Cache as the incoming CEO/COO/VP/GM/President of a newly acquired portfolio company.

Our Operating Partners are experienced leaders and operators currently working within a Software as a Service or Service-Based businesses in a sales, marketing, operations, or key management role. If you have a demonstrable track record of success and are looking to run an internet-based business as its operating CEO/COO/VP/GM/President we’d love to hear from you.

Applying as an Operating Partner puts you in our network for consideration when we acquire new businesses generating $500K-$5M in revenue. Operating Partners should expect excellent and unique compensation packages including equity and/or profit share participation.

Our Strategy

  • Plug & Play Systems — We use our proven playbooks to create and curate a database full of potential customers and invest in bringing value to them on an ongoing basis.
  • Remote Workforce — With a global footprint, we operate with a distributed team covering multiple time zones capable of serving our multinational customer base.
  • Winning Spirit — We bring a creative solutions mindset to problem-solving. No defeat, be optimistic. Pretty much everything is fixable, and most decisions are reversible.
  • Bunts & Singles — Narrow down the market to a specific customer that we can be the best at serving, and grow from there.

Our Thesis

There are intelligent entrepreneurs globally that are adept at identifying and building great software. Once these companies reach product-market-fit, it’s not uncommon for the company to grow beyond the founders’ core competencies.

By infusing capital and adding infrastructure, we can enable businesses to realize their full potential while continuing to scale the revenue profitably.

Our Focus

We seek to minimize risk and maximize returns, meaning we only invest in companies with a clear predictable path to success.

We will consider all types of business software and service companies, and specifically focus on the following:

  • Enterprise Software
  • SMB Software
  • Vertical Market Software
  • Tech Enabled Managed Services
  • IT Consulting
  • Ecommerce Software

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of operational leadership experience.
  • 5+ years of experience managing direct and/or indirect reports.
  • Extensive knowledge in operations, including resource planning, demand planning, business planning, corporate strategy, communications, leadership, benchmarking, and forecasting.
  • Required skills in market research, analytics, financial modeling, metrics analysis, and presentations.
  • Strong proficiency in Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize workloads and meet time-sensitive deadlines.
  • Must be results-oriented and adaptable to changing priorities.
  • Exceptional verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, capable of interacting with all levels of associates with tact and diplomacy.
  • Proven ability to protect confidential information.
  • Ability to travel by automobile and aircraft, with the flexibility to be away from home for extended periods.
  • Experience in managing external relations, including identifying, diversifying, building, and maintaining relationships with community organizations and leaders to secure various forms of support and partnerships.
  • Ability to manage solicitations with board members and sponsors, provide outcome reports, and lead cultivation and stewardship activities for charitable endeavors.
  • Unique compensation packages including equity and/or profit share participation.
  • Competitive Health, Dental, and Vision benefits.
  • Work from anywhere in the world.
  • Loose vacation policy.
  • Flexible work hours.

We are building the infrastructure of the automotive aftermarket in Latin America, and the Vertical Manager – Auto Parts will own one of its most strategic missions: digitizing and scaling millions of SKUs across Tier 1, 2, and 3, while shaping the future of our marketplace.

  • Opportunity to lead the most strategic vertical in one of the largest industries in Latin America.

  • A high-impact environment where your decisions shape the future of the business.
  • Competitive compensation package with performance-based incentives.

  • São Paulo: BRL R$18,900 – R$24,200 gross / month + bonus.

description:
Precisamos de um(a) fornecedor(a) com experiência em criar conteúdos educacionais, sólido conhecimento sobre Bases da IA – conceitos, evolução, tipos e algoritmos aplicáveis. Agro e Transformação Digital – características do agro brasileiro, desafios tecnológicos e iniciativas de inovação. Dados no Campo – fontes (sensores, drones, satélites, sistemas de gestão), tipos de dados, pré-processamento, armazenamento, pipelines de dados e qualidade. Aplicações da IA – pecuária de precisão (monitoramento, saúde, alimentação, produtividade) e integração de tecnologias (drones, IoT, decisões em tempo real). IA Generativa – usos no agro (relatórios, previsões, simulações, assistentes virtuais), modelos disponíveis, ferramentas e limitações. Mercado e Cases – startups, plataformas e resultados alcançados. Ética e Sustentabilidade – uso responsável de dados e automação, impactos ambientais, inclusão digital e desafios regulatórios, clareza na comunicação escrita e capacidade didática.

ENTREGAS PARA ESTA DEMANDA:

Analisar o conteúdo bruto e roteiros para garantir a pertinência temática e a atualidade das informações. Realizar correções de erros conceituais. Propor melhorias para o entendimento do conteúdo. Analisar a linearidade e coesão do texto, adicionando exemplos práticos para facilitar a compreensão e a contextualização. Análise e Otimização Visual (Imagens): Conferir as imagens presentes no material, verificando sua correção, adequação ao tema, público-alvo e contexto. Propor substituições de imagens, se necessário, indicando opções de bancos de imagens ou imagens autorais com boa resolução. Garantir que as imagens selecionadas ou propostas estejam em alta qualidade e resolvam visualmente as necessidades do texto. Garantia de Qualidade e Alinhamento: Validar as atividades e seus feedbacks para assegurar que simulam casos reais e incentivam a tomada de decisão. Validar materiais complementares, confirmando sua adequação ao público-alvo e sugerindo novos, se pertinente. Assegurar que o produto final esteja conforme a expectativa do cliente e do público, com linguagem e visual adequados, conforme especificações do curso. Responsabilizar-se por sinalizar e implementar os ajustes necessários para garantir a integridade e precisão do conteúdo. Conferir e recomendar bibliografia ou material complementar. Capacitação: Realizaremos um momento de alinhamento e capacitação com o validador, para garantir que ele compreenda integralmente as diretrizes pedagógicas, os objetivos do curso e os parâmetros esperados para a atualização. Validação interna da equipe (DI): Após a entrega do conteúdo validado, a DI realizará uma leitura e solicitará os ajustes necessários, assegurando a coerência pedagógica, a aderência aos objetivos de aprendizagem e a qualidade do material produzido. Ajustes e refinamento do conteúdo: Caso sejam identificadas inconsistências ou oportunidades de melhoria, o conteúdo retornará para ajustes por parte da conteudista, seguindo as orientações da DI. Finalização e conclusão da demanda: Com os ajustes finalizados e o conteúdo aprovado internamente, consideraremos a etapa de atualização concluída, encerrando a entrega conforme o escopo previsto no contrato.

PARA PRESTAR ESTE SERVIÇO VOCÊ PRECISA DE:

Expertise nos temas mencionados acima. Desejável experiência em validação de material didático para EaD;

Overview

About the Role

We are building the infrastructure of the automotive aftermarket in Latin America, and the Vertical Manager – Auto Parts will own one of its most strategic missions: digitizing and scaling millions of SKUs across Tier 1, 2, and 3, while shaping the future of our marketplace.

This role is designed for someone ready to go beyond Key Account Management and step into a position of ownership, strategy, and impact. The ideal candidate will combine analytical rigor, commercial instinct, and executional drive to lead the growth of the most critical vertical in our ecosystem.

  • A high-impact environment where your decisions shape the future of the business.
  • Competitive compensation package with performance-based incentives.

Why this role exists

We create ads that make the phone ring for roofers. You’ll turn raw ideas and footage into scroll-stopping creative, edit content fast, and support campaign execution. If you can edit content at a high level, you’re a #1-priority candidate—design skills matter, but content editing chops win.

What you’ll do (outcomes, not busywork)

  • Produce ad creative: Design static graphics and short-form video for Meta / TikTok / YouTube / Display; iterate quickly based on performance data.
  • Edit content end-to-end: Cut UGC, before / after, job-site clips; add captions, hooks, overlays, CTAs; ship multiple variations.
  • Build offer / angle packs: Translate roofing value props (financing, storm damage, warranties, same-day inspection) into hooks, headlines, and visuals.
  • Launch + maintain assets: Prep export specs, thumbnails, landing page hero graphics, and ad library organization.
  • Brand standards: Create and maintain lightweight brand kits per client (logos, palettes, typography, truck / crew photos).
  • Creative testing: Set up A / B creative matrices; document learnings; kill losers, scale winners.
  • Light marketing ops: Assist with ad uploads, naming conventions, UTM hygiene, and creative calendars.
  • Industry learning: Rapidly absorb what makes roofing ads work: seasonality, storm events, insurance language, compliance “do’s and don’ts.”

Must-have skills & experience

  • 2–5+ years in graphic design and / or content editing (agency, in-house, or freelance). Roofing / home services / renovation background strongly preferred.
  • Editor-first: Premiere Pro, CapCut Pro, or Final Cut + After Effects basics. Figma / Adobe Illustrator / Photoshop proficiency.
  • Proven portfolio of direct-response creative (ads that sell, not just look pretty).
  • Strong sense of hooks, pacing, and clarity; understands attention economics for 3–30s ads.
  • Comfortable working from raw, imperfect footage (phone clips, job-site audio) and making it look sharp.
  • Solid copy instincts: headlines, overlays, lower-thirds, CTA placement.
  • Organized: version control, file naming, and asset libraries.

Nice-to-haves

  • Roofing / home services portfolio (before / after, crew, drone, hail / storm angles).
  • UGC direction: writing briefs, coaching talent, shot lists.
  • Basic landing page design (Figma / Webflow / Canva) and thumbnail optimization.

What success looks like (90-day scorecard)

  • Ship 30–50 creative variations / month across clients (mix of video + static).
  • Hit ≥ 3 winning creatives / month (defined as 20–40%+ lift in CTR / CVR vs. control).
  • Build / maintain client brand kits and a searchable asset library.
  • Document a Creative Playbook for roofing offers, angles, and compliance.

KPIs you’ll own

  • Thumb-stop / 3-sec view rate (shorts / reels).
  • CTR on first-touch ads; CPL contribution for lead gen funnels.
  • Creative velocity: variants shipped per week and on-time rate.
  • Iteration speed: time from data insight → new variant live.

Tools we use

Adobe CC (Premiere / AE / PS / AI) or CapCut Pro, Figma, Google Drive, Slack, Notion, Meta Ads Library, Frame.io (or equivalent).

Work setup

Fully remote. Standard working hours 9:00–5:00 PM Central (CDT). Occasional optional travel for content capture or team onsites.

Compensation

  • $500–$1,000 per month (DOE) + performance bonus tied to creative wins.
  • Benefits (if full-time): PTO, holidays, gear stipend, education budget.
  • Growth path: Senior Creative → Creative Lead (own testing roadmap and junior designers).

How to apply

Apply via our website: (Careers / Contact). Include:

  • Portfolio link + 2–3 ad examples with a one-liner on why they worked
  • Your tool stack + availability
  • Confirmation you can work 9:00–5:00 PM CDT (align your timezone)

Paid test (required)

We’ll give you a raw roofing job-site folder (clips + stills). In 48 hours, deliver:

  • 2 x 15s vertical ads (3 hook variants each)
  • 2 static ads (before / after + financing angle)
  • Project file + export settings + a one-page rationale

Role expectations (how we work)

  • Iterate fast. Done > perfect; perfect comes from rounds of data-driven edits.
  • Own the result. If CPL is high, you propose creative fixes—don’t wait for orders.
  • Be practical. Clarity beats clever. Results beat awards.

Equal Opportunity

We hire for skill, speed, and integrity. All backgrounds welcome.

We are looking for a Graphic Game Designer to work closely with our Game Producer on the gamification track of our EdTech platform (Cognitive Development).

Important: This is not about building complex or heavy games. The focus is on expanding our portfolio of simple, highly engaging mini-games, quizzes, brain-training challenges, and test-like interactions.

Your main responsibility will be to design and produce these games together with the Game Producer. While the Producer defines the mechanics (rules, flow, retention loops), you will translate them into playable, smooth, and visually delightful mini-games using Framer Motion and other tools.

Success will be measured not only by the visual quality of your work, but by its impact on retention, how well the games keep users engaged and coming back.

  • AI Tools: Use AI design tools to accelerate production while maintaining quality.
  • Consistency & Quality: Ensure all games meet a high visual and usability standard.
  • Collaboration: Work directly with the Game Producer, turn game mechanics into playable, visually polished experiences.

  • Strong sense of aesthetics, attention to detail, and user-centered design.
  • Ability to deliver quick, high-quality work in a high-pressure environment.

Nice to have

  • Experience with casual/mobile games or gamification.
  • Motion design & micro-interactions expertise.
  • Understanding of retention/engagement-focused design.
  • Experience in EdTech or mobile-first consumer products.

Location

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

Benefits

Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

Interview Process

After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review, which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps:

  • Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)

Regime : PJ | Full Remote | Tempo integral

Sobre a ReviewAll

Somos uma consultoria especializada em recrutamento e seleção para o ecossistema de startups e empresas de tecnologia. Atualmente, atendemos mais de 50 clientes, que vão desde early-stage, empresas seed-invested e startups Series A / B / C / D até grandes multinacionais.

  • Acompanhamento de onboarding
  • Ser ponto único de contato para stakeholders (tech leads, PMs, diretores e founders), garantindo clareza de expectativas

Requisitos

  • Formação: Nos importamos mais com experiência prática do que formação superior.
  • Experiência: Sólida em executive search, conduzindo de 8 a 12 vagas simultâneas de nível sênior e gerencial, com foco na qualidade da entrega e evitando ser “impressora de currículos”. Foco em recrutamento estratégico e com entrega rápida / efetiva. Nosso SLA de entrega são 5 dias úteis, e nossa taxa de fechamento é entre 3 - 6 indicados.

Perfil

  • Altamente organizado e orientado a resultados
  • Excelente comunicação interpessoal
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em ritmo acelerado
  • Resiliência à pressão e postura hands-on
  • Curioso: Nosso perfil é pesquisar sobre vagas, criar estratégias de hunting ground, conseguir ter base para entrevistar candidatos de forma qualificada.
  • Somos uma empresa jovem, com cultura dinâmica, rápida, e anti-burocrática. Se você se identifica com essa linha, será bem-vindo.

Infraestrutura

  • Computador próprio e conexão de internet estável

O que não se alinha com o nosso jeito de trabalhar

  • Dificuldade em lidar com ritmo intenso e alta pressão: Nosso dia a dia é acelerado e está em constante transformação. Quem precisa de supervisão constante, tem dificuldade com pressão ou busca um ambiente previsível pode não se adaptar bem aqui.
  • Ausência de senso de responsabilidade e rejeição à autonomia: Esperamos postura de dono: tomar decisões, assumir riscos e gerar resultados. Quem depende de orientação constante ou busca validação o tempo todo provavelmente não terá espaço. Aqui, o protagonismo é essencial e valorizado com participação nos resultados.
  • Resistência a feedbacks francos e cultura de transparência: Prezamos pela clareza e sinceridade. Feedbacks são recorrentes e parte do nosso desenvolvimento. Isso exige maturidade para aceitar críticas construtivas com abertura e humildade.

description:
Explore the Nearsure experience!

Join our close-knit LATAM remote team : Connect through fun activities like coffee breaks, tech talks, and games with your team-mates and management.

Say goodbye to micromanagement! We champion autonomy, open communication, and respect for diversity as our core values.

Plus, our Accounts Management team ensures smooth, effective client relationships, so you can focus on what you do best.

Ready to grow with us?

Here’s what we offer you by joining us!

Competitive USD salary – We value your skills and contributions!

100% remote work – While you can work from anywhere, you’re always welcome to connect with teammates and grow your network at our coworking spaces across LATAM!

Paid time off – Take the time you need according to your country’s regulations, all while receiving your full salary. Rest, recharge, and come back stronger!

National Holidays celebrated – Take time off to celebrate important events and traditions with loved ones, fully embracing your culture.

Sick leave – Focus on your health without the stress. Take the necessary time to recover and feel better.

Refundable Annual Credit – Spend it on the perks you love to enhance your work-life balance!

Team-building activities – Join us for coffee breaks, tech talks, and after-work gatherings to bond with your Nearsure family and feel part of our vibrant community.

Birthday day off – Enjoy an extra day off during your birthday week to celebrate in style with friends and family!

About the project :

As a NAV / Business Central Architect , you will bring a strong background in full-cycle implementations, upgrades, and technical architecture, along with proficiency in developing scalable and maintainable solutions aligned with business needs.

How your day-to-day work will look like

Design and lead the technical architecture of Microsoft Dynamics NAV and Business Central solutions.

Develop customizations, integrations, and extensions using AL and standard BC development tools.

Participate in NAV / BC version upgrade and migration projects, maintaining system integrity and logic.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and deliver scalable solutions.

Ensure solution quality through code reviews, documentation, and adherence to best practices.

Support go-live processes and post-implementation stabilization activities.

Guide junior developers and contribute to internal knowledge sharing.

This would make you the ideal candidate

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

8+ Years of experience working with Microsoft Dynamics NAV and Business Central.

5+ Years of experience working with Microsoft SQL.

5+ Years of experience working with SSRS.

Solid understanding of AL language and development using Visual Studio Code.

Proficiency in creating reports using RDLC.

Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI / CD processes.

Advanced English Level is required for this role, as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.

What to expect from our hiring process

1. Let’s chat about your experience!

2. Impress our recruiters, and you’ll move on to a technical interview with our top developers.

3. Nail that, and you’ll meet our client - your final step to joining our amazing team!

At Nearsure, we’re dedicated to solving complex business challenges through cutting-edge technology and we believe in the power of tailored solutions. Whether you are passionate about transforming businesses with Generative AI, building innovative software products, or implementing comprehensive enterprise platform solutions, we invite you to be part of our dynamic team!

We would love to hear from you if you are eager to make an impact and join a collaborative team that values creativity and expertise.

Let’s work together to shape the future of technology!

Apply now!

title: Escalation Manager
description:
Overview

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Your Career

The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and / or sales opportunities with key customers.

The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers\' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.

In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.

Your Impact

  • Escalation Leadership
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution
  • Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers
  • Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling
  • Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate
  • Expedite Resolution
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues
  • Clear accountability on relevant owners on driving to target service-level Objectives(SLO) and intermediate milestones leading up to it
  • Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner
  • Communication and Reporting
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties
  • Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO
  • Set clear customer expectations and ensure timely updates on troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer facing communications
  • Risk Management
  • Make informed decisions on elevating urgency and apply relevant focus to solve for a situation with right governance, guardrails and reviews in place
  • A “whatever it takes” customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Retrospective and Preventive Measures
  • Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process / system / product
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems
  • Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas
  • Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address
  • Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Customer Experience
  • 10+ years of customer-facing sales and / or service delivery roles
  • Past experience as Escalations Engineer / Manager, Technical Account Management, Engineering Management, Customer Support Management, or similar roles desired
  • Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators
  • Program / Project management
  • Manage critical issues in a cross-functional environment that includes working with support, customer success, professional services, sales, customers, and partners to resolve complex and critical issues
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize with a goal of driving issues to closure on behalf of the customer
  • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Asana, Tableau, JIRA and experience in running and operating with the SLA / SLO / Milestones paradigm and clarity on what success and corresponding metrics looks like
  • Collaboration and Influence
  • Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers
  • Leadership and communication skills
  • Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals
  • Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)
  • Technical skills
  • Experience with Networking / Security Products
  • Knowledge of LAN / WAN technologies, encompassing general routing / switching / security for both branch and data center architectures
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales teams, and other invested parties
  • Creative thinking, adaptability, and versatility
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Strong ability to influence and effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future issues

Additional Information

The Team

The Escalation Managers are part of the Global Incident and Escalation Management team which part of Global Customer Support and Service teams covering all Palo Alto offerings of cybersecurity platforms and solutions.

Team is responsible for driving expedited response, remedy, resolution, and learnings for our most critical issues. Escalation Managers(EM) team ensures focused technical leadership, effective coordination and communication, and streamlined decision-making

As Escalation Managers, each team member will be at the vanguard of our dedication to cybersecurity. Addressing the most pressing situations for our customers, you will hold a central position in solidifying our reputation as the go-to cybersecurity partner. This role demands proactivity, efficiency, an unwavering dedication to constant refinement, and a passion for customer satisfaction.

Driving continuous learnings and efficiency into the Escalation Management and Product Lifecycle is one of the key areas for the team as we continue our focus on customer experience.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple : we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers\' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.

  • Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution

  • Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations

  • 10+ years of customer-facing sales and / or service delivery roles
  • Past experience as Escalations Engineer / Manager, Technical Account Management, Engineering Management, Customer Support Management, or similar roles desired
  • Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators

  • Ability to multitask and prioritize with a goal of driving issues to closure on behalf of the customer

  • Collaboration and Influence
  • Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers
  • Leadership and communication skills
  • Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals
  • Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)
  • Technical skills
  • Experience with Networking / Security Products
  • Knowledge of LAN / WAN technologies, encompassing general routing / switching / security for both branch and data center architectures

  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales teams, and other invested parties
  • Creative thinking, adaptability, and versatility
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Strong ability to influence and effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future issues

Additional Information

The Team

The Escalation Managers are part of the Global Incident and Escalation Management team which part of Global Customer Support and Service teams covering all Palo Alto offerings of cybersecurity platforms and solutions.

Team is responsible for driving expedited response, remedy, resolution, and learnings for our most critical issues. Escalation Managers(EM) team ensures focused technical leadership, effective coordination and communication, and streamlined decision-making

As Escalation Managers, each team member will be at the vanguard of our dedication to cybersecurity. Addressing the most pressing situations for our customers, you will hold a central position in solidifying our reputation as the go-to cybersecurity partner. This role demands proactivity, efficiency, an unwavering dedication to constant refinement, and a passion for customer satisfaction.

Driving continuous learnings and efficiency into the Escalation Management and Product Lifecycle is one of the key areas for the team as we continue our focus on customer experience.

Our Commitment

description:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for someone with a strong media and advertising foundation; well versed in Google Campaign Manager, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Ads, planning, presenting, executing, and optimizing all media strategies.

Our ideal candidate thrives on data and is adept at using it to craft the highest performing campaigns possible. We’re seeking someone who is well organized, attentive to detail, and most importantly is as passionate as the rest of our team is about driving results overnight and building stronger brands over time. Above all, we think having the right positive, engaged personality is crucial for our work culture and to create a passionate tie to our agency’s thriving team philosophy.

Media Planning & Strategy

  • Develop comprehensive media plans aligned with client goals and target audiences.
  • Conduct in-depth research and analysis to identify optimal media channels and strategies.
  • Determine budget allocation across channels based on performance and objectives.
  • Stay abreast of emerging digital media trends, technologies, and AI integrations.
  • Advise the New Business teams and Account teams on recommended budgets and media strategies during the pitch process.

Campaign Execution & Management

  • Oversee the execution of paid media campaigns across various platforms (e.g., Google Ads, social media platforms, programmatic display).
  • Manage relationships with external vendors responsible for day-to-day campaign management.
  • Track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as leads, cost per acquisition (CPA), cost per lead (CPL), engagement rates, web traffic, and form fills.
  • Analyze campaign performance data to identify areas for optimization and improvement. Generate regular reports on campaign performance and insights.

Budget Management

  • Manage and allocate media budgets effectively across channels to maximize campaign performance.
  • Maintain daily, weekly, and monthly budget pacing and ensure campaigns remain on schedule and within financial targets.
  • Identify opportunities for cost-saving without compromising campaign effectiveness.

Skills & Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in media buying, preferably in an agency setting or with companies providing B2B services/recruiting to software development firms.
  • Strong experience in paid media platforms (Google Ads, Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Ads, programmatic platforms).
  • Proven track record of managing performance marketing campaigns with a focus on results.
  • Proficiency in analytics and attribution tools (Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, third-party trackers, etc.).
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Proficiency with media buying and planning tools.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

Estamos em busca de um(a) Agente de Viagens com experiência em reservas e suporte a clientes corporativos, com disponibilidade para atuar em turnos noturnos e nos fins de semana. Se você é organizado(a), autônomo(a) e com habilidades em resolução de problemas, queremos te conhecer!

Exemplo 2 – concentrado em 1 dia : das 09h às 19h ou das 03h às 13h

Type: Full-time (open to contractor-to-hire)

Why this role exists

We create ads that make the phone ring for roofers. You’ll turn raw ideas and footage into scroll-stopping creative, edit content fast, and support campaign execution. If you can edit content at a high level, you’re a #1-priority candidate—design skills matter, but content editing chops win.

  • Light marketing ops: Assist with ad uploads, naming conventions, UTM hygiene, and creative calendars.
  • Industry learning: Rapidly absorb what makes roofing ads work: seasonality, storm events, insurance language, compliance “do’s and don’ts.”

Must-have skills & experience

  • 2–5+ years in graphic design and / or content editing (agency, in-house, or freelance). Roofing / home services / renovation background strongly preferred.
  • Editor-first: Premiere Pro, CapCut Pro, or Final Cut + After Effects basics. Figma / Adobe Illustrator / Photoshop proficiency.
  • Proven portfolio of direct-response creative (ads that sell, not just look pretty).
  • Strong sense of hooks, pacing, and clarity; understands attention economics for 3–30s ads.
  • Comfortable working from raw, imperfect footage (phone clips, job-site audio) and making it look sharp.
  • Solid copy instincts: headlines, overlays, lower-thirds, CTA placement.
  • Organized: version control, file naming, and asset libraries.

Nice-to-haves

  • Roofing / home services portfolio (before / after, crew, drone, hail / storm angles).
  • UGC direction: writing briefs, coaching talent, shot lists.
  • Basic landing page design (Figma / Webflow / Canva) and thumbnail optimization.

What success looks like (90-day scorecard)

  • Ship 30–50 creative variations / month across clients (mix of video + static).
  • Hit ≥ 3 winning creatives / month (defined as 20–40%+ lift in CTR / CVR vs. control).
  • Build / maintain client brand kits and a searchable asset library.
  • Document a Creative Playbook for roofing offers, angles, and compliance.

KPIs you’ll own

  • Thumb-stop / 3-sec view rate (shorts / reels).
  • CTR on first-touch ads; CPL contribution for lead gen funnels.
  • Creative velocity: variants shipped per week and on-time rate.
  • Iteration speed: time from data insight → new variant live.

Tools we use

Adobe CC (Premiere / AE / PS / AI) or CapCut Pro, Figma, Google Drive, Slack, Notion, Meta Ads Library, Frame.io (or equivalent).

Work setup

Fully remote. Standard working hours 9:00–5:00 PM Central (CDT). Occasional optional travel for content capture or team onsites.

Compensation

  • $500–$1,000 per month (DOE) + performance bonus tied to creative wins.
  • Benefits (if full-time): PTO, holidays, gear stipend, education budget.
  • Growth path: Senior Creative → Creative Lead (own testing roadmap and junior designers).

How to apply

  • Portfolio link + 2–3 ad examples with a one-liner on why they worked

  • Confirmation you can work 9:00–5:00 PM CDT (align your timezone)

Paid test (required)

We’ll give you a raw roofing job-site folder (clips + stills). In 48 hours, deliver:

  • 2 x 15s vertical ads (3 hook variants each)

Role expectations (how we work)

Equal Opportunity

title: Business Development Manager
description:
About Us

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.

The Role

As Vendry’s Business Development Manager, you’ll be the frontline force helping brands kick off their search for the right agency partner, helping to craft their marketing strategies in the process. You’ll be responsible for leading our sales efforts with inbound RFP clients—those who have already expressed interest in starting an agency search through Vendry. This is not a traditional outbound-heavy role. Instead, it’s about deeply understanding each client’s needs, pitching our process, running intro calls, managing follow-ups, and ensuring a seamless transition into the matchmaking phase.

You’ll serve as both consultant and salesperson, ensuring that every interested brand sees the value in Vendry’s approach—and ultimately trusts us to guide them through their agency selection journey.

Responsibilities

  • Own the full sales cycle for inbound agency search clients—from initial inquiry through signed engagement with our partners.
  • Conduct consultative sales calls to understand each client’s marketing needs and present Vendry’s search process.
  • Build and deliver compelling pitch materials and follow-ups that reflect Vendry’s value proposition.
  • Collaborate closely with the Agency Operations team to ensure smooth handoff and client experience.
  • Maintain detailed records in our CRM to track pipeline activity and conversion metrics.
  • Help evolve our sales materials and process based on feedback and performance.

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience in a sales or client-facing role, ideally in marketing, advertising, or agency services.
  • Proven ability to run structured sales calls and close consultative deals.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Organized, self-motivated, and comfortable managing multiple prospects at once.
  • Experience working in a remote environment and using CRM tools like HubSpot or Salesforce.
  • Based in Canada and able to work full-time remotely.

Why Join Vendry

Joining Vendry means joining a team at the forefront of transforming how brands find their marketing partners. You’ll work directly with marketers at companies big and small, helping them discover agencies that can take their brand to the next level. We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team that values creativity, strategic thinking, and initiative.

If you’re a self-starter with a passion for marketing and building relationships, we’d love to hear from you.

  • Familiar with Web Services: XML, REST, SOAP.

  • Experience with integrations with and/or use of BI tools such as GoodData (preferred), Tableau, PowerBI, or similar.
  • Broad experience with multiple RDBMS: MS SQLServer, Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redshift.
  • Familiarity with SaaS/cloud data systems (e.g. Salesforce).

  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining data pipelines.

What you\'ll be doing

  • Develop and maintain data models for core package application and reporting databases to describe objects and fields for support documentation and to facilitate custom application development and data integration.
  • Monitoring execution and performance of daily pipelines, triage and escalate any issues.
  • Collaborates with analytics and business teams to improve data models and data pipelines that feed business intelligence tools, increasing data accessibility and fostering data-driven decision-making across the organization.
  • Implements processes and systems to monitor data quality, ensuring production data is always accurate and available for key stakeholders and business processes.
  • Writes unit/integration tests, contributes to engineering wiki, and documents work.
  • Performs data analysis required to troubleshoot data-related issues and assist in the resolution of data issues.
  • Work within AWS/Linux cloud systems environment in support of data integration solution
  • Works closely with a team of frontend and backend engineers, product managers, and analysts.
  • Teamwork: Collaborate with team members. Share knowledge, provide visibility of interpersonal accomplishments and follow directions when provided.

Company Benefits

  • Technology / Office stipend

  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

description:
About Remote

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

The Position

This is an exciting time to join Remote and make a personal difference in the global employment space as a VP, Growth Marketing.

In this role, you will own the data-driven marketing strategy to grow our top-of-funnel and increase marketing’s contribution to revenue.

You will report directly to the CEO and work closely with GTM, Product, Data, and other teams to turn growth into a durable, compounding engine for the business.

What You Bring

  • Proven track record driving growth strategy in a fast-paced, high-performance environment.
  • Deep expertise in performance marketing, lifecycle, web strategy, and product-led growth, with a strong analytical foundation.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias for action and comfort owning outcomes.
  • Experience leading innovation — building new playbooks, not just running existing ones.
  • Ability to attract, grow, and retain top talent while fostering intensity and accountability.
  • Strategic thinker who can zoom out to vision and zoom in to flawless execution.
  • It is not required to have experience working remotely, but considered a plus.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end growth marketing strategy to grow top-of-funnel pipeline and accelerate closed-won revenue.
  • Build and manage a high-performing Growth Marketing team, agencies, and vendors, setting high performance standards and fostering a culture of innovation and operational excellence.
  • Lead full-funnel growth initiatives with an emphasis on top-of-funnel expansion across paid, organic, ABM, and emerging channels.
  • Define, track, and report on core growth metrics (CAC, LTV, retention, conversion, incremental lift), translating data insights into actions that improve efficiency and scalability.
  • Architect and refine attribution methods (MMM, MTA, experimentation frameworks) to measure channel effectiveness and optimize spend.
  • Develop and execute a continuous experimentation plan to uncover and scale new growth levers for customer acquisition.
  • Drive B2B strategies including vertical messaging and persona-based tactics to increase lead quality and accelerate pipeline velocity.
  • Partner with different teams, including Sales, Revenue Operations, Product, and Data, to ensure a cohesive GTM strategy and a seamless customer journey that maximizes revenue outcomes.

Remote Compensation Philosophy

Remote\'s Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair equity pay along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. We do not agree to or encourage cheap-labor practices and therefore we ensure to pay above in-location rates. We hope to inspire other companies to support global talent-hiring and bring local wealth to developing countries.

At first glance our salary bands seem quite wide - here is some context. At Remote we have international operations and a globally distributed workforce. We use geo ranges to consider geographic pay differentials as part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive in various markets while we hiring globally.

The base salary range for this full-time position is $210,250- $315,350. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay for the successful candidate in this role is dependent upon many factors such as location, transferable or job-related skills, work experience, relevant training, business needs, and market demands. The base salary range may be subject to change.

At Remote, we foster internal mobility as a key element of our culture of employee growth and development, supported by a compensation philosophy that guarantees pay equity and fairness. Therefore, all compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed by the Total Rewards & People Enablement team on a case by case basis.

title: Paid Media Specialist
description:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

Here’s What You’ll Get To Work On:

  • Managing Google Ads Campaigns: Launch, monitor, and optimize campaigns across Search, Display, and Video.
  • Bottom-of-Funnel Focus: Prioritize conversions that go beyond lead generation, including SQLs, pipeline impact, and closed-won revenue.
  • Collaboration with Sales Teams: Partner closely with sales to align on lead quality, refine campaign targeting, and maintain a strong feedback loop.
  • Performance Analysis & Reporting: Create dashboards and evaluate campaign results using Google Analytics, Looker Studio, and spreadsheets.
  • Full-Funnel & Lead Quality Insights: Deep knowledge of the buyer journey and how paid media influences progression through the funnel.
  • A/B Testing & Creative Iteration: Conduct A/B tests on targeting, ad creatives, landing pages, and bidding tactics to drive performance gains.
  • Cross-Channel Integration: Collaborate with the broader marketing team to maintain cohesive messaging and strategic alignment across all channels.
  • Landing Page & CRO Collaboration: Coordinate with design teams to enhance landing page effectiveness and improve conversion rates.
  • Budget Management & Forecasting: Manage spend pacing and performance targets, with clear reporting on ROI and CAC.
  • Platform Expansion: Research and experiment with emerging ad formats and placements within the Google Ads platform.

Here’s the experience we’re looking for:

  • Expertise in Google Ads: Over 5 years of hands-on experience managing paid campaigns across Google Search, Display, and Video.
  • Full-Funnel Focus: Skilled in tracking and optimizing campaigns beyond top-of-funnel leads, with an emphasis on driving revenue.
  • Strong Analytical Abilities: Proficiency in using Google Analytics, spreadsheets, Looker Studio (or similar tools), and analyzing campaign performance data.
  • Collaboration with Sales: Proven experience partnering with sales teams to enhance campaign impact on the sales pipeline.
  • Advanced Conversion Tracking: Knowledgeable in UTM parameters, pixel setup, and using Google Tag Manager for tracking.
  • Proficient in English: Effective in communicating and collaborating in English across teams and documentation.
  • CRM Awareness: Understanding of how paid media campaigns connect with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot.

Here’s what we’re looking for this role to achieve:

  • Drive higher revenue attributed to marketing through Google Ads campaigns.
  • Enhance SQL rates and boost lead-to-deal conversions via paid media channels.
  • Develop a collaborative workflow with the sales team to assess and refine lead quality.
  • Lower cost per acquisition (CPA) while improving return on ad spend (ROAS) and customer acquisition cost (CAC) efficiency.
  • Expand a full-funnel paid media strategy aligned with customer purchasing behaviors.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

description:
Ainda com várias aplicações, foque em talentos específicos. Se acredita que tenha 100% de fit conosco, candidate-se.

Regime : PJ | Full Remote | Tempo integral

Sobre a ReviewAll

Somos uma consultoria especializada em recrutamento e seleção para o ecossistema de startups e empresas de tecnologia. Atualmente, atendemos mais de 50 clientes, que vão desde early-stage, empresas seed-invested e startups Series A / B / C / D até grandes multinacionais.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar de 8 a 12 processos seletivos simultâneos nas áreas de tecnologia, produto e negócios. Grande parte das vagas em nível executivo.
  • Conduzir o recrutamento end-to-end.
  • Alinhamento de perfil diretamente com o cliente final e área de pessoas de nossos clientes.
  • Sourcing ativo ( Recruiter, job boards, networking)
  • Triagem de currículos e entrevistas técnicas e comportamentais
  • Apresentação de shortlist e negociação de oferta
  • Acompanhamento de onboarding
  • Ser ponto único de contato para stakeholders (tech leads, PMs, diretores e founders), garantindo clareza de expectativas

Requisitos

  • Formação : Nos importamos mais com experiência prática do que formação superior.
  • Experiência : Sólida em executive search, conduzindo de 8 a 12 vagas simultâneas de nível sênior e gerencial, com foco na qualidade da entrega e evitando ser “impressora de currículos”. Foco em recrutamento estratégico e com entrega rápida / efetiva. Nosso SLA de entrega são 5 dias úteis, e nossa taxa de fechamento é entre 3 - 6 indicados.

Perfil

  • Altamente organizado e orientado a resultados
  • Excelente comunicação interpessoal
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em ritmo acelerado
  • Resiliência à pressão e postura hands-on
  • Curioso : Nosso perfil é pesquisar sobre vagas, criar estratégias de hunting ground, conseguir ter base para entrevistar candidatos de forma qualificada.
  • Somos uma empresa jovem, com cultura dinâmica, rápida, e anti-burocrática. Se você se identifica com essa linha, será bem-vindo.

Infraestrutura

  • Computador próprio e conexão de internet estável

O que não se alinha com o nosso jeito de trabalhar

  • Dificuldade em lidar com ritmo intenso e alta pressão : Nosso dia a dia é acelerado e está em constante transformação. Quem precisa de supervisão constante, tem dificuldade com pressão ou busca um ambiente previsível pode não se adaptar bem aqui.
  • Ausência de senso de responsabilidade e rejeição à autonomia : Esperamos postura de dono : tomar decisões, assumir riscos e gerar resultados. Quem depende de orientação constante ou busca validação o tempo todo provavelmente não terá espaço. Aqui, o protagonismo é essencial e valorizado com participação nos resultados.
  • Resistência a feedbacks francos e cultura de transparência : Prezamos pela clareza e sinceridade. Feedbacks são recorrentes e parte do nosso desenvolvimento. Isso exige maturidade para aceitar críticas construtivas com abertura e humildade.
  • Apego a horários fixos : Somos uma consultoria em expansão acelerada. Problemas surgem a qualquer momento, e as soluções também. Valorizamos quem entrega com excelência mesmo que isso demande flexibilidade de agenda.

Pacote de remuneração

  • Salário Fixo PJ
  • Variável mensal : potencial médio de R$ 3.000 – 8.000 (com atingimento de meta mensal, é esperado R$4.500 - 6.000), sem teto.
